website.how: The site is titled "Keith Self for Congress" and carries an endorsement asking the voters of TX-03 to send Keith Self back to Congress.
The site is titled "Elect Evan Hunt", says "I'm running for Congress" and describes TX-03; it is paid for by Elect Evan Hunt.
The site is titled "Jake Ellzey for Congress" and says he represents Congressional District 6 in Texas; paid for by Jake Ellzey for Congress.
dannyminton.com redirects here. The site is titled "Danny Minton for Texas | Texas Congressional District 6" and says he is running for Congress in Texas' 6th District.
The site is titled "Alex Mealer for Congress | TX-09" and says she is running for Congress for TX-09.

offices.office: Public Safety Chair, METRO (the Houston-area transit authority), representing the 14 multi-cities in its service area; worded as the campaign's site words it, which gives no years

website.how: The site is titled "Leticia Gutierrez for Congress District 9" and calls her the Democratic candidate for TX-09 on November 3.
The site is titled "Craig Goldman for Congress" and says he represents Texas District 12 in Congress; paid for by Craig Goldman for Congress.
The site is titled "Angela 'Heli' Rodriguez Prilliman For Congress TX-12" and calls her the Democratic candidate for United States Representative, District 12.
The site is titled "Monica De La Cruz for Congress", has a TX-15 page, and is paid for by Monica for Congress.

review.shows: Her Bioguide id D000594 is also attached to another candidate, Carlos de La Cruz (Republican, 2026-TX-H35, FEC id H6TX35087), so the people table gives him her birth date (1974-11-11) and her U.S. House service since 2023, and his card would link to her record.
review.problem: The Clerk of the House's member profile for D000594 is Monica De La Cruz, Texas 15th, Republican; Carlos de La Cruz is a different person, a candidate in district 35, and is not that member.
